Overview

Posture and operations, delivered as one managed service

One managed service that unifies application security posture and operations — from risk-prioritized visibility to SLA-backed remediation — delivered as an extension of your team.

nTrust ASPM/AppSOC consolidates signals from SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets scanning, and runtime telemetry into a single risk-ranked backlog — then monitors, triages, and responds to application-layer threats 24/7/365. Our security engineers continuously verify, prioritize, and guide remediation so your team works on what actually matters, with every action documented for auditors and regulators.

The service is in controlled rollout. Register your interest and we will notify you as onboarding slots open.
